name: Chiropractor

pf.license.need: always: each chiropractor holds their own active chiropractic license (DC) from the state where the patient is seen
pf.license.who: each person; the clinic too where the state's form registers chiropractic clinics or their owners
pf.license.ask: each chiropractor's license number in their invite reply (or the owner sends it); the clinic's registration and its X-ray machine's registration, where the state's form asks
pf.license.check: none: Rosie never looks up, checks or confirms a license, insurance or registration (D96); anything shown is as given by the business, not checked by Rosie
pf.license.blocks: nothing waits on a license (D96): the business and each person go live once set up and the owner says yes; a job the owner says needs a license they don't have isn't booked
pf.license.away: house calls and workplace care days only where the state's rules allow chiropractic care away from the clinic (a switch)
pf.license.acupuncture: acupuncture only by a licensed acupuncturist, or by a chiropractor with the state's own acupuncture certificate where the state allows it (a switch from the state form)
pf.license.xray: X-rays only on a machine registered where the state's form asks, taken by someone the state allows (a switch)
pf.license.video: off: chiropractic care is hands-on; if a clinic turns video on, only chiropractors licensed in the state the patient is in that day
pf.license.agreement: a health privacy agreement (a HIPAA business associate agreement) signed on the secure page before the first booking; every company in Rosie's chain signs one with Rosie
pf.license.renewals: optional reminders the owner sets; a license the owner says has lapsed pauses that person's new bookings for that work (the owner's word, never a check)
pf.license.insurance: malpractice insurance where the state's form asks for it

pf.services.shape: visit types on a treatment table, each with a set length; a new patient's first visit is a history, an exam, and a first adjustment only if the chiropractor finds it safe; X-rays only when the chiropractor orders them; a care plan's visits are booked as a series only with the patient's own yes, and each is paid when it happens; a re-exam after each block of care
pf.services.examples: the example clinic's own prices (Lee Chiropractic and Lee Mobile Chiro), not a standard; a plan pays its own fee, and the patient's share is an estimate

list.name: New patient visit (history, exam, and a first adjustment if it's safe)
list.kind: one price; the plan's estimate is shown when a plan pays
list.before: nothing taken (a card saved only where the clinic turns on its $20 no-show fee)
list.after: at the front desk: the self-pay price, or the plan's share
list.note: new-patient times are kept apart (Sam's booking rules)

list.name: Adjustment (a follow-up visit)
list.note: a care plan's visits; each is paid when it happens

list.name: Prenatal adjustment
list.note: only a chiropractor trained for prenatal care (Dr. Chen at the example clinic)

list.name: Kinesio taping
list.where: added to a visit, both places

list.name: Child's adjustment (12 and under)
list.note: a parent or guardian books, signs the consent and stays

list.name: Re-exam
list.note: after each block of care, on the date the chiropractor's care plan sets

list.name: Full spine X-rays
list.note: only if the chiropractor orders them; the price is shown first, and the patient says yes

list.name: Car accident or work injury visit
list.price: billed to the auto or work injury claim
list.after: the clinic bills the claim its own way
list.note: the claim number goes on the secure page first, and the desk confirms the claim before the visit

list.name: First house call (history, exam, and a first adjustment if it's safe, on a portable table)
list.before: a card saved for the $89 no-show fee, or nothing taken
list.after: the saved card charged when the chiropractor texts DONE, or Rosie texts the bill

list.name: House-call adjustment
list.before: a card saved for the $89 no-show fee
list.after: the saved card charged at DONE

list.name: Extended house call (a longer visit)
list.before: a card saved for the $89 no-show fee, or nothing taken
list.after: the saved card charged at DONE, or Rosie texts the bill
list.note: also when a re-exam finds a visit needs more time; the new price is shown first, and the patient says yes

list.name: Workplace care day
list.price: $120 an hour, paid by the employer
list.where: at the host's place, on set days
list.after: the employer pays the business its own way
list.note: only with the employer's standing OK on file

list.name: Missed house call or late cancel
list.note: only from a saved card, and only when the owner confirms it

pf.services.capacity: one patient per table; the X-ray room is booked with the X-ray visit; the portable table is booked like a person
pf.services.nobodyHome: never: the patient is always there

beforeTimes: for you, your child, or someone you help
new or returning patient (a new patient gets the 60-minute new patient visit)
which visit: the clinic's own visit types only, never a symptom typed into the AI
a car accident or a work injury (then it's billed to that claim)
a health plan (its name only), Medicare, or paying yourself
afterTime: anything that helps at the visit, like the step-free door or an interpreter
at home: who will be there, where to park, and room for the portable table
securePage: plan member ID and a photo of the insurance card
for a car accident or work injury: the claim number and the adjuster
health history: the problem, past injuries, medicines, conditions, pregnancy
consent to care, after the chiropractor's main risks are explained, and the privacy notice
a parent's or guardian's consent for anyone under 18
pf.questions.whoMayBook: an adult for themselves; a parent or guardian for anyone under 18, who stays for the visit; a guardian or health care agent for an adult who can't consent; a minor alone only where the state's rules let minors consent to care (a switch)
pf.questions.neverAsked: symptoms, the reason for the visit and results are never asked or typed in the AI chat; words typed there are checked for danger, then not kept

stop.words: chest pain, trouble breathing, a sudden very bad headache, or sudden weakness, numbness, a drooping face or slurred speech
stop.say: This needs help now. Call 911. Don't wait for a chiropractor visit.

stop.words: numbness in the groin or inner thighs, new trouble controlling the bladder or bowels, leg weakness that's getting worse, back pain with a fever, or a head injury or trouble walking after a crash or fall
stop.say: This needs a doctor now. Go to an emergency room, or call 911. Don't wait for a chiropractor visit.
stop.booking: no booking; the same words texted before a visit get the same message, the owner is told and calls, and the visit stays unless the patient cancels, with no fee

goOn.words: an everyday back or neck strain, also after a car accident
goOn.what: books as usual (a car accident visit is billed to the claim); Rosie only matches words and never judges how serious anything is

pf.safety.owner: the clinic's own red-flag list, set with its chiropractors at sign-up, is the stop list above; Sam can add words that go to the clinic's own line (A3-26)
pf.safety.always: the general screen: danger to life, fire, gas or a medical emergency gets 911, and words about self-harm get 988

steps.name: Health history and consent
steps.when: on the secure page only, never by text; due the day before the visit (a same-day visit: before the time is held); one reminder before it's due
steps.who: every new patient; returning patients once a year, or when their health changes
steps.result: the consent is signed after the chiropractor explains the main risks, before any adjustment; not done by its due date: Sam keeps the visit (signed on the secure page at the desk or the door first), moves it, or cancels with no fee

steps.name: The plan check
steps.when: while booking, by the front desk, by hand
steps.who: every patient who names a plan
steps.result: covered (the copay, visits left), some services only (like Medicare: adjustments, not the exam or X-rays), not covered, or can't check now (the desk checks later, and the patient may cancel free)

steps.name: The claim for a car accident or work injury
steps.when: on the secure page while booking; the desk confirms it before the visit
steps.who: every patient whose visit is billed to a claim
steps.result: no claim confirmed: the visit stays at the self-pay price, or a free cancel

steps.name: A written price estimate for self-pay patients
steps.when: told while booking; sent within 1 business day (the example clinic's rule), or sooner where the rules require it; a new one when a care plan is added
steps.result: a to-do for the front desk, with its due date

steps.name: A Medicare cost notice
steps.when: on the secure page before a visit Medicare may not pay for, like an upkeep adjustment; the desk explains it at check-in
steps.result: signed: the patient knows that part may be self-pay; not signed: the desk explains it before any care, and the patient may cancel with no fee

steps.name: A re-exam before more adjustments
steps.who: a returning patient with no exam in the last 12 months
steps.result: the chiropractor goes on, suggests another plan, or refers the patient to a medical doctor

steps.name: The employer's OK for a workplace care day
steps.who: the employer hosting the care days
steps.result: no OK: no times at that place

pf.first_steps.prep: arrive 15 minutes early; bring a photo ID and the insurance card; wear loose, comfortable clothes; at home: a clear space about 7 by 4 feet for the portable table

pf.visit.checkIn: at the clinic: the check-in code at the front desk, with a photo ID; at home: the code at the door; at a workplace: the code at the care day's table
pf.visit.beforeWork: the chiropractor reads the health history, takes the history and examines (posture, movement, reflexes, strength and feeling in the legs), with their own red-flag checks, before any adjustment
pf.visit.changes: X-rays only if the chiropractor orders them, with the price shown first and the patient's yes; something that needs a medical doctor first means no adjustment, the visit is paid, and notes go to the doctor the patient names; a care plan is suggested in person, stays on the secure page, and is never pushed
pf.visit.carePlan: a care plan's visits are booked as a series only with the patient's own yes by text; one reply stops any visit, or all that are left
pf.visit.done: the check-in code or DONE; notes, X-rays and results stay in the clinic's own records, shared with the patient only in person, never in Rosie or a text
pf.visit.away: a portable table; no X-rays at home (ordered at the clinic or an imaging center)

pf.money.before: nothing taken at booking at the clinic; a card saved only where the clinic turns on its $20 no-show fee, never for a fee-free patient; at home: a card saved for the $89 no-show fee and charged at DONE, or nothing saved and Rosie texts the bill; a car accident or work injury: nothing taken
pf.money.plans: the plans the clinic takes (its own list); the front desk checks each by hand and records it: active or not, the chiropractic benefit (the copay, visits left, the deductible); the share is an estimate, not a promise; Medicare pays only for adjustments that correct a current problem, not the exam, X-rays or upkeep visits
pf.money.claims: a car accident or work injury is billed to that claim, the business's own way; the claim details go only on the secure page
pf.money.selfPay: a self-pay patient is told while booking that they can get a written price estimate, and gets it on time; a bill far above it can be disputed (the federal rules set how)
pf.money.packages: none at the example clinic: each visit is paid when it happens; where a clinic sells prepaid visits, the state's rules on prepaid care apply (a switch)
pf.money.fees: the missed-visit or late-cancel fee: $20 at the clinic and $89 for a house call (the example's own), only from a saved card and only when the owner confirms it; the same fee for every patient who may be charged one
pf.money.feeFree: a switch: no fee ever for patients whose plan or the state's rules bar one (like Medicaid, where that applies), or whom the owner marks fee-free; a Medicare patient pays a fee only if every patient does; their texts say 'No fee to cancel or miss'
pf.money.after: at the clinic: the self-pay price or the plan's share at the front desk, its own way; the clinic sends the plan's claim; a balance after the plan pays is billed by the clinic, not by Rosie's text; at home: the saved card charged at DONE, or Rosie texts the bill; a claim or an employer is billed the business's own way
pf.money.rosfield: the $2 per booking applies to this work, as to every kind of work (D97): a flat fee for each booking Rosie's AI makes, shown at sign-up for the owner's yes; a booking the business puts in itself carries no $2; card payments cost only Stripe's own card fee, paid to Stripe
pf.money.caps: deposit cap: from the state form; fee limits for plan patients: from the plan's and the state's rules
pf.money.repeatPlans: a repeating visit plan (like an adjustment every 4 weeks) is booked only with its own yes; each visit is paid when it happens, like a single visit: at the front desk at the clinic, or at home by the saved card at DONE or Rosfield's bill; no monthly plan charge and nothing paid ahead

pf.messages.never: texts carry only the clinic's name, the date, the time, the address and a secure link: never the visit type, the plan, the reason, the results or the chiropractor's name (on a house call the chiropractor's name stays, for the door check); X-rays and results never go through Rosie
pf.messages.staff: texts to the owner and staff use the patient's initials only (A.M., never Alex M.) and never the reason for the visit
pf.messages.healthQuestions: Rosie never answers a health question, like ice or heat; it goes to the clinic, which calls the patient
pf.messages.minors: a minor's texts go to the parent or guardian
pf.messages.decider: for an adult who can't consent, the texts go to the person who decides, and the code to whoever meets the chiropractor

pf.staff.licenses: each chiropractor's own license, per state; an acupuncturist's own license
pf.staff.skills: chiropractors: exams, adjustments, reading X-rays, kinesio taping; prenatal care only by a chiropractor trained for it (here Dr. Chen); the front desk: check-in, plan checks, estimates and payment; only people cleared for house calls go to homes and workplaces
pf.staff.supervision: a chiropractic assistant (taping, hot and cold packs) works only while a chiropractor is there, as the state's rules allow (a switch)
pf.staff.oks: the owner OKs same-day visits, any price made for one patient (at the clinic, every one, like a custom brace; for house calls, over $500, like a care plan's total), and anything a chiropractor flags
pf.staff.standIn: a chiropractor out: another chiropractor takes their patients where there's room, and the patient chooses; the patient never hears why someone is out
pf.staff.away: the house-call team: Dr. Brooks and Dr. Moore, each with a portable table

pf.rules.records: chiropractic records are kept by the clinic as long as the state's rules require (a child's may be kept longer); a delete request removes only Rosie's own booking details, never the clinic's records
pf.rules.copies: a patient's copy of their records within the time the rules set; Rosie sends only booking and payment records
pf.rules.consent: written consent after the main risks are explained, before any care, where the state's rules require it (a switch)
pf.rules.prepaid: prepaid visits and packages follow the state's rules (written terms, a cancel, a refund of unused visits): a switch; the example clinic sells none
pf.rules.showLicense: the license shown where the state asks: posted at the clinic, and on a house call
pf.rules.minors: who may consent for a minor, and at what age a minor may consent alone (a switch from the state form)
pf.rules.host: a workplace care day only under the employer's written OK and its sign-in rules (S1-58, B4-66)
pf.rules.ads: no free-visit or price claims the state's rules don't allow
pf.rules.privacy: health privacy rules for every message and form

pf.edges.lateArrival: up to 15 minutes late: still seen, in the time left; later: the front desk may move the visit, with no fee (Rosie never moves it itself)
pf.edges.standIn: a chiropractor out: another chiropractor with room, or new times with no fee
pf.edges.forms: a form not done by its due date: one reminder, then Sam keeps the visit (signed on the secure page before any care), moves it, or cancels with no fee (A7-74, B7-61)
pf.edges.planChange: the plan check comes back not covered: self-pay, or a free cancel
pf.edges.redFlagBefore: red-flag words texted before a visit: the emergency room message, the owner is told and calls, and the visit stays unless the patient cancels, with no fee
pf.edges.referral: something in the exam needs a medical doctor first: no adjustment, the visit is paid, and notes go to the doctor the patient names
pf.edges.carePlan: a care plan's visits are booked only with the patient's own yes; one reply stops any visit or all that are left; no sales texts
pf.edges.twoBookings: a patient with several care plan visits open: Rosie asks which one before any change
pf.edges.healthQuestion: a question about ice, heat or exercises before the visit goes to the clinic; Rosie gives no advice
pf.edges.urgent: no service is sent now and nobody is on call (S2-30, S2-31): sudden back pain gets the soonest same-day time, with the owner's OK; the red-flag words get the emergency room or 911 message
pf.edges.other: all other edge cases the generic way
